question: Which two statements about Avaya Messaging Release 11 are true? (Choose two.) A. A Microsoft Windows operating system is not provided with the Avaya Messaging software bundle. B. A licensed copy of Microsoft Windows 2019 operating system is included in the Avaya Messaging software bundle. C. Avaya Messaging can be installed on a shared server. D. Avaya Messaging must be installed on dedicated servers specifically intended for the Messaging application purpose.

Which three statements about the recommended hardware requirements of Avaya Messaging Server installation are true? (Choose three.) A. All hard drives must be high performance, server grade drives. B. All processors are to be 3.5 GHz or better. C. Different configurations must be used for both physical and virtual servers. D. Configure the CPU for Performance mode in the server's BIOS settings. E. All processors are to be 2.0 GHz or better.

What is the order of Avaya Messaging server installation in a High Availability architecture solution? A. WebLM Server > Primary Server > Consolidated server > All Secondaries B. WebLM Server > Primary Server > All Secondaries > Consolidated server C. WebLM Server > Consolidated server > Primary Server > All Secondaries D. Primary Server > WebLM Server > Consolidated server > All Secondaries

Which statement about the Avaya Messaging secondary/backup Consolidated Server is true? A. From Release 11, Carbonite software is no longer required to perform replication between the primary and secondary Consolidated Servers. B. Avaya Messaging Release 11 requires Carbonite software to perform replication between the primary and secondary Consolidated Servers. C. A secondary/backup Consolidated Server is no longer a supported option from Avaya Messaging release 11. D. The primary and secondary Consolidated Servers must be located on the same LAN.

In the event of one or more VSN failures in a High Availability architecture, which component provides continuous voice messaging and message retrieval to all registered users? A. Carbonite server B. Consolidated Server C. Content Sync Engine D. Remaining Voice Server Node(s)
Which two email servers support Contact Sync and Calendar Sync? (Choose two.) A. IBM Lotus Notes B. Google Apps Gmail C. Exchange 2013 – 2019 D. Office 365

In Avaya Messaging, what are the default Voicemail and Application User passwords? A. default Voicemail password: '12345'; default Application User password: 'admin'. B. default Voicemail password: '02468'; default Application User password: 'password'. C. default Voicemail password: '13579'; default Application User password: 'password'. D. default Voicemail password: '11111'; default Application User password: 'password'.
